subject: King's Petroleum Sign Denials
overview: The committee met to address a petition regarding sign permit denials for three gas stations on Salem Street. Members voted to table the matter to facilitate a meeting between the petitioner and the Building Department to resolve procedural issues.

items.title: King's Petroleum Sign Denial Petition
items.summary: Tabled a petition to reverse sign denials for three gas stations to allow the petitioner to meet with the Building Department to resolve procedural confusion dating back to 2019.
